title: Compare constant pressure and volume
statement:
Which equation applies for a reaction with only PV work carried out at constant pressure?

[_]{a}

choices: Heat necessarily equals the internal-energy change.
explanations: This follows from H=E+PV under the stated conditions.
PV work can occur as volume changes.
Constant pressure does not fix volume.
A reaction can release or absorb heat.

hints: Check what kind of work is possible.
solution: At constant pressure with only PV work, $q_p=\Delta H$.
